note: A voice_id is an identifier, not a secret, so it is committed. The API key never is: it lives in packages/web/.env.local, which .gitignore covers.
modelNote: v3 over multilingual_v2: far more expressive, and it returns exactly one timestamp per character (v2 returned 22 for a 20-character line), so the typewriter can index the alignment array directly.
settingsNote: v3 reads stability as three discrete modes: 0.0 Creative, 0.5 Natural, 1.0 Robust. Natural is deliberate. Creative is more theatrical line by line but drifts in timbre across a 102-line corpus, and one character speaking in two voices is worse than one speaking slightly flatter.
